Class BasicHtmlWriter

java.lang.Object
java.io.Writer
org.apache.juneau.marshall.serializer.SerializerWriter<SELF>
org.apache.juneau.marshall.xml.XmlWriter<SELF>
org.apache.juneau.marshall.html.HtmlWriter<BasicHtmlWriter>
org.apache.juneau.marshall.html.BasicHtmlWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, Flushable, Appendable, AutoCloseable
public class BasicHtmlWriter extends HtmlWriter<BasicHtmlWriter>
Concrete HtmlWriter leaf for standard HTML output.

This is the directly-instantiable form of HtmlWriter, which is itself an abstract CRTP self-type base so it can also be extended (e.g. by SimpleHtmlWriter or by the body-var-resolving anonymous writer in BasicHtmlDocTemplate).

Notes:
  • This class is not intended for external use.
